The '''Morishim system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Morish]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
